question: Can the staged bundle replace g4 using offer-s for cedar, and what must happen before publication?

criteria.instruction: No. Cedar is selected class S and lacks its own required reviewed source-offer label. Spruce's offer-s is for an unselected component and cannot satisfy cedar. Validate all selected metadata/text bindings, retain separate attributions and obtain cedar's own reviewed offer before any complete replacement. A blocked attempt leaves g4 unchanged.
Use inventory missing offer, D22 class rules and pending repair review. Distinguish staged broken output from a published g5.
Do not invent or borrow an offer, silently remove cedar from approved selection, publish partial output or claim g5/customer distribution occurred.
